{{Otheruses|Whip}}
[[File:Entangled_BtS.png|thumb|right|250px|Boba Fett uses his fibercord whip against Luke Skywalker]]
A '''fibercord whip''', also known as a '''smart-rope''' or a '''monolink filament''', was a projected length of [[Fibercord/Legends|fibercord]] used to ensnare an individual. A [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] was usually attached to the end. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] employed this device against [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when they fought on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used a fibercord whip against [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] when he suspected him of attacking [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="The Star Wars Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref> The bounty hunter would also use that device to ensnare Skywalker at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Skywalker struggled, but managed to sever the cord with a blaster bolt deflected using his lightsaber.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
